text: A hospital cannot use equipment that is still waiting for
procurement review. Across Africa, public procurement averages
seventeen percent of GDP, according to the World Bank.
In Zambia, Quorum starts with the officer's desk:
read the evidence, identify the gaps, and prepare a decision
that people can explain.
This is one fictional Zambia tender for ten vaccine
refrigerators. Two timely bids, prices in kwacha, and
criteria issued before evaluation.
Technical capability carries sixty percent;
delivery carries forty. The demonstration contains no real
supplier's tax record. The source documents and starting state
are included so a reviewer can reproduce the result.
Muse Spark on Meta Model API compares each
admitted bidder against those same criteria.
Here is the actual returned review, beside its source.
One supplier commits to delivery within thirty days and names a
local service team. The other says delivery will be agreed after
award. Quorum checks every quotation against that bidder's
documents. An invented quotation is rejected.
Missing evidence becomes a question for the committee.
The model advises; it does not enter official scores or decide
the award.
Now the boundary that makes this useful in a public institution.
The LangGraph review stops at a pending human gate.
These are captured responses from the real HTTP approval path.
An unsigned direct request is refused.
An authenticated request without step-up verification is also
refused. After both attempts, the gate is still pending and
there is no filing receipt.
The review graph has no edge to filing.
Changing the model's instructions cannot add one.
A separate authorised test account now completes two-factor
verification. The server checks office authority, committee
Quorum and the gate-bound assertion before accepting the
decision. Only then does the simulation produce a sealed
receipt. Its signature verifies.
This is a local filing simulation on fictional data;
it is not a government portal transaction.
The accountable decision remains with authorised people.
The evidence bundle includes the model response, exact source
files, failed requests and verified receipt.
Tests cover quotation grounding, access controls and replay
protection. A procurement officer study is prepared, but no
time saving or money recovered is claimed before real officers
measure it. The next step is a consenting procurement
unit reviewing one retrospective tender.
Built by Chungu Chama.

workflow. Explore the source and reproduce the demonstration.
